name: OmaWaniKani
author: aphelion-studios
description: A WaniKani cockpit for the bar: reviews and lessons due at a glance, a 24-hour forecast, the next-review countdown, and where you stand in the current level. Full lesson and review sessions come in a later release.

barWidget.description: A quiet Crabigator mark that takes the accent colour while reviews are waiting, with a dashboard drop-down for the numbers.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar re-reads your review and lesson counts from WaniKani. WaniKani allows 60 requests per minute; each refresh uses two.

schema.label: Light the mark for lessons too
schema.description: Give the mark the accent colour when lessons are waiting, not only reviews.

schema.label: Hide the mark when nothing is due
schema.description: The mark still appears while no API token is stored, so you can always reach the panel to connect one.

schema.label: Notify at N reviews
schema.description: Send a notification when your review count climbs past this. 0 turns it off. Notifications follow Do Not Disturb.
